title: Micah's Promise of Rebuilding and the Subjugation of the Nations
description: A prophetic vision from Micah about the day when God's people will be rebuilt, walls raised and borders expanded. People will come from Assyria and Egypt, from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain, while the land lies desolate because of its inhabitants' deeds. The Lord will guard his people with his staff like a flock on Carmel, Bashan and Gilead, and let them see wonderful things as when they came out of Egypt. Nations will see it and be put to shame, lay their hand over their mouth, lick the dust like a serpent and come trembling from their strongholds to fear the Lord.
